title: On de Rham--Witt Cohomology of Classifying Stacks
summary: We give an example of proper smooth fourfold over a perfect field k of characteristic p > 0 with asymmetric Hodge--Witt numbers in total degree 3. Our example is sharp both in terms of dimension and total degree. We arrive at our example by computing and approximating the Hodge--Witt cohomology groups of the classifying stack B alpha_p.
